note: Round 7: the fight sets (World.FightSets) place textured meshes from the free Creator Store models below through World.AssetKit. Only their mesh and texture ids are used (SpecialMesh FileMesh on quiet parts, built by code); no model, script or other instance from them is in the game. Everything else in the world is built from parts, Roblox 2022 materials, SurfaceGuis and terrain created in code; particle and beam textures are Roblox built-ins (rbxasset://textures/...). The five stage ambience sounds are re-used by CL.LobbyAmbience as positional loops.
